content:
The BIM Guide in The Municipalities is already published, which aims to sensitize the municipalities to the theme of Building Information Modelling (BIM), a project coordinated by Antonio Aguiar Costa of BUILT CoLAB.

This document aims to define the fundamental concepts to support BIM implementation initiatives in a municipality, considering the complexity of this innovative way of working and its impact on organizations, especially in organizations as diverse as local authorities.

Thus, this guide can be considered as a guideline for the implementation of the digitization of construction and infrastructure, and in particular of BIM.

In addition to the coordination of António Aguiar Costa, Research, Development and Innovation Director of BUILT CoLAB, he also counted on the contribution of several BIM professionals and academics in Portugal: Miguel Azenha, João Poças Martins, Ricardo Pinho, Luís Ribeirinho, Marta Campos, Inês Rodrigues and Ricardo Cunha Reis. The preface is by Fernando F. S. Pinho, Coordinator of the Regional College of Civil Engineering of the Southern Region of the Order of Engineers.

You can read this document in BUILT Insights.
